recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in FHIR core unless a future ballot issue requests different Patient.address or Patient.communication wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13617 is a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration technical correction requesting that Patient.address and Patient.communication definitions use singular descriptions, specifically "An address..." and "A language...", instead of plural wording for repeating elements.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-13617-tagged source commit was found in the available git history. The current Patient StructureDefinition source already contains the singular Patient.address short/definition and singular Patient.communication short/definition, and the older plural Patient.communication phrase from the Jira comment is absent from current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Patient as an active resource in the patient folder and marks Patient as approved/normative, so source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml is in current build scope. Jira searches for the two element paths and singular/plural Patient wording found only FHIR-13617, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion or conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped Patient source already satisfies the requested singular wording and no source edit would change implementer understanding.
